**Auditor:** Grok 4.6 (xAI), high effort, read-only. Terminal state: audit complete. Claimed candidate digest `bd29c1b5323dcf385ce10f281cabc6e43f4ed726dfc0358919ee85c22896dfcb` (supplied text; digest not recomputed in this no-tool session). This is one full-candidate vote on the **workflow plan only**. It does not dispose D0–D6, freeze S0 bytes, accept the MIL/3 draft, or accept any implementation.

# Verdict: WARN

The plan matches the checkout constraints that matter: one active delivery item, SP01.6 left blocked, no invented `cli.py run` action, S0 limited to literal-fee transfer plus funded AccrualFirst repay, GPT-6 implementation with fresh Grok 4.6 high and GPT-6 Astra audits, two substantive agreeing votes, U0 exit left open (66 absent embeddings, 0 covered K rows, 84 unenforced leaves), and workflow agreement does not start I1. Follow it only after the fixes below are written into the candidate bytes and the changed bytes are re-audited.

## Findings

**W1. Workflow `D1` collides with draft `D1`; no D1–D11 crosswalk.**
Anchor: workflow §2 table (`D1` = signature binding) plus “Map the draft's D1–D11 … by subject”; draft §10 (`D1` = arithmetic placement / Ω).
A recorded “D1” disposition can bind the wrong subject.
**Fix:** Prefix live issue IDs (for example `W-D0`…`W-D6`) and add this crosswalk in §2 before any I0 packet:

| Live issue | Draft / source labels |
|---|---|
| W-D0 first slice | U0 S0 (not in draft §10) |
| W-D1 signature | MIL/2 §11 vs U0 in-circuit proposal |
| W-D2 language contract | draft §3 |
| W-D3 stage/failure | draft §4; obligations O7, O12 |
| W-D4 numeric/economic | draft D1, D2, D3, D4, D10 |
| W-D5 evidence/duties/bridge | draft D6, D7, D8 |
| W-D6 category admission | draft D5, D9, D11 and all eight §8 families |

**W2. I1 can be read as routine source repair while SP01.6 still occupies the delivery slot.**
Anchor: workflow §4 “guarded failure blocks its dependent dispatch, not all independent source repair” next to I1 “actual S0 stage preparation”; startup/skill: one active item = SP01.6, blocked, no pending transactions.
I1 is a delivery implementation item. Editing `mil3-stage-v1.ts` / `src/cli.ts` under the repair exception would open a second active item.
**Fix:** Add to §4: “I1 is a delivery implementation item. It remains blocked while SP01.6 occupies the active slot. Routine source-repair permission does not cover I1 files. If no registered `cli.py run` transition frees the slot, I1 stays blocked; this workflow adds no such action.”

**W3. Skill-route reconciliation is timed after I1.**
Anchor: workflow §2 “reconcile the applicable user instruction before future product dispatch”; §4 I1 = GPT-6 product implementation; AGENTS.md vs September 10 skill route.
I1 is a product dispatch.
**Fix:** Replace that phrase with: “Reconcile this checkout’s AGENTS.md (GPT-6 implementer, Grok 4.6 high + GPT-6 Astra audits) with the skill’s September 10 general-product route before I1. Record which instruction governs I1. Leave the conflict visible until that record exists.”

**W4. M3-D is allowed to present as scoped U0-F without keeping the 2026-09-23 exit open.**
Anchor: workflow §3 “It can support a scoped U0-F semantic contract”; U0 EXIT-GATE: contract recorded, capabilities OPEN (66 absent, 0 covered K, 84 unenforced, compatible tuple not established).
**Fix:** Add to the M3-D row: “Any S0-subset freeze uses label U0-F and leaves `deliverables/u0-semantic-contract-2026-09-23/` counts unchanged. M3-D does not close, replace, or re-score that exit.”

**W5. I1 names a “canonical stage record” for fixture pre-state.**
Anchor: workflow §4 I1; draft §4 `Stage` requires authenticated `s@h`, `HistoryLink`, `AuthorityFresh`; workflow itself: live resource state unavailable.
**Fix:** Name the I1 object a “local prepared-stage candidate from named fixture pre-state.” List `HistoryLink`, live-head authentication, K, native, and ledger as open on that path. Keep “canonical stage record” for M3-R once those conjuncts are evidenced.

**W6. S0-blocking D4 leaves Qty width unset.**
Anchor: workflow §2 D4 “Set S0 exact arithmetic first, then decide … width”; §6 “checked add/subtract, comparison and min at admitted widths”; U0 numeric profile OPEN (17 primitives, 6 gaps); draft §10 D2 width still live.
I0 cannot freeze S0 arithmetic on an unnamed width.
**Fix:** In the S0 part of D4/I0: either cite the exact U0 numeric-profile width for add/sub/min/compare, or open a new versioned width decision. State that pool/vault `u112` and Ω/divmod stay outside S0.

**W7. §2 “Select S0 provisionally” reads as a D0 disposition.**
Anchor: workflow §2 D0 Immediate scope; §6 next packet still covers D0–D3; “No draft recommendation becomes a disposition by being copied.”
**Fix:** Add: “Approval of this workflow disposes no W-D0–W-D6 row and is not M3-D. ‘Select S0 provisionally’ is the I0 packet’s proposed alternative, live until two agreeing votes on frozen S0 bytes.”

**W8. Repay fixtures can be reported as originate.**
Anchor: workflow §1/§6: originate excluded; S0 repay of an existing obligation; I1 named fixture pre-states.
**Fix:** Add to I1: “Repay pre-state is a fixture-authored existing obligation. That snapshot does not admit originate or accrue.”

## Required byte changes before reuse

Write W1–W8 into the workflow candidate. Recirculate the new digest to both auditors. Keep I0 unstarted until W-D0–W-D3 and the S0 part of W-D4 are disposed on frozen S0 contract bytes. Keep I1 unstarted until that I0 freeze, the one-active-item check, and any required registered campaign transition are done.

Astra’s vote is still required. Record Astra’s returned identity and effort when it arrives. An absent reviewer supplies no vote.
